title: Eleven Winters and One Short Road
subtitle: 城市发展 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 城市发展（人与社会·历史、社会与文化）
meta: 主题语境：城市发展（人与社会·历史、社会与文化）　|　核心词汇：expansion　|　正文 340 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 expansion 的含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: In 1976 my uncle ① planned an expansion that no councillor in the town would have approved, and he said the planning was the whole of the winter. The ② expansion, meaning the growth itself and not the map, ran eleven winters and stayed unapproved in the book; an expansion, he said, is the only thing in a town that is judged by how long it is left unapproved.

Every ③ expansion in that town had the same short road beside it, and the ④ expansion at the far side, meaning the one they kept for the school and not either of those, was the only one anybody ever thanked twice. An expansion, my mother said, is nine parts patience and one part somebody willing to approve; my uncle said the approving is the part that fills eleven winters.

My aunt meant the other thing entirely: she said ⑤ the expansion was the whole of the argument, meaning the widening and not the growth. The ⑥ expansion, meaning the widening and not any of that, is the only thing in an argument that everybody waits for and nobody approves; expansion, she said, is either something you plan or the only word that means both growth and a widening. She said the widening is the part they remember.

By 1984 the ⑦ expansion had become a line in a report, and the report had become an argument about the short road. The ⑧ expansion of the whole thing, my uncle wrote in January, was one town and eleven winters of approving; expansion, he said, is either the one at the far side or the reason you learned to approve. He said the approving was never mentioned.

The ⑨ expansion I remember is the one approved in the report, which closed in 1988 and is still described as the quietest in the town. An ⑩ expansion, my mother said in 1990, is the only one that improves by being approved; every expansion, she said, is a widening that has agreed to look like growth. She said the widening was the honest half.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请将对应义项填入表中。
options: A. n. 扩张；扩展（指镇上每一次旁边的那一次）
B. n. 扩张（指那一次扩展本身，与地图相对）
C. 固定搭配：plan an expansion 规划一次扩建
D. n. 扩建（指留给学校的那一次）
E. n. 扩张（抽象总称，指一个镇子上的扩建之事）
F. n. 扩建（指报告上写到、被批准的那一次）
G. n. 扩大；扩充（指一场争论里人人都等却无人批准的那样东西）
H. n. 扩充（抽象总称，指人人都等却无人批准的那样东西）

items.q: planned an expansion that no councillor in the town would have approved
The expansion, meaning the growth itself and not the map
the expansion at the far side
the expansion was the whole of the argument
the expansion had become a line in a report
The expansion of the whole thing
An expansion, my mother said in 1990

answers.why: plan an expansion 意为“规划一次扩建”，1976 年叔叔规划了一次镇上没有一位议员肯批准的扩建。
expansion 意为“扩张”，指那一次扩展本身而不是地图，它经过了十一个冬天而在簿子上没有记号。
expansion 意为“扩张”，指镇上每一次旁边的那一次，每一次旁边都有同一条短短的路。
expansion 意为“扩建”，指留给学校的那一次，是唯一有人谢过两次的。
expansion 意为“扩大、扩充”，指一场争论里人人都等却无人批准的那样东西，姑姑说这次扩充就是那场争论的全部。
expansion 意为“扩充”，指人人都等却无人批准的那样东西而不是那一次扩展，是争论里人人都等、却无人批准的东西。
expansion 意为“扩建”，指报告上写到、被批准的那一次，到 1984 年这一次成了报告里的一行。
expansion 意为“扩张”，叔叔一月写道，整件事的扩建之事是一个镇子和十一个冬天的批准。
expansion 意为“扩建”，我记得的是报告上批准的那一次，1988 年结束了，至今仍被说成镇上最安静的一次。
expansion 为抽象总称，母亲 1990 年说，一次扩建是唯一会因为被好好批准而变得更好的东西。
